recipes.name: Cubanos inspired by Chef
ingredients: 1 whole head garlic cloves, peeled and crushed
1 whole head garlic cloves, peeled and crushed
2 tbsp toasted and freshly ground cumin
instructions: Trim excess fat from the pork shoulder and score the fat cap. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the orange juice, water, rice wine vinegar, rum, kosher salt, brown sugar, garlic, oregano, rosemary, thyme, sage, and bay leaves. - 1 large bone in pork shoulder - 4 cups orange juice - 2 cups water - ½ cup rice wine vinegar - ½ cup spiced rum - ½ cup kosher salt - ¼ cup dark brown sugar - 1 whole head garlic cloves peeled and crushed - 2 stems fresh oregano roughly chopped - 2 stems fresh thyme roughly chopped - 2 stems fresh sage roughly chopped - 3 bay leaves
Submerge the pork shoulder in the brine, cover, and refrigerate for at least 12 hours. - For the Pork Shoulder & Brine

In a separate bowl, combine the olive oil, orange zest and juice, lime zest and juice, oregano, cilantro, mint, garlic, salt, pepper, and cumin. Whisk to combine. - ½ cup olive oil - 3 oranges zest and juice - 6 limes zest and juice - 2 stems fresh oregano roughly chopped - ½ cup fresh cilantro chopped - ¼ cup fresh mint leaves chopped - 1 whole head garlic cloves peeled and crushed - 1 tbsp kosher salt - 1 tbsp freshly ground black pepper - 2 tbsp toasted and freshly ground cumin

Remove the pork shoulder from the brine, discarding the brine. Place the pork in a stainless steel bowl and coat with the mojo marinade, massaging it into the meat for 1 minute. - For the Pork Shoulder & Brine - For the Mojo Marinade
Cover and refrigerate for an additional 2 hours - For the Pork Shoulder & Brine - For the Mojo Marinade
Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Remove the pork from the marinade, brushing off large herb pieces, and place it on a wire rack set in a rimmed baking sheet. - For the Pork Shoulder & Brine

Roast for 2.5 hours, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F at the thickest point. Tent with foil and let rest for 30 minutes (or refrigerate until ready to use). - For the Pork Shoulder & Brine
Butter the cut sides of the pan Cubano and toast butter-side down on a hot plancha until golden. - 4 tbsp butter at room temperature - 1 loaf pan Cubano quartered
Slice the pork shoulder into ¼-inch slices. In a nonstick pan, lightly sear the sliced pork and ham. - For the Pork Shoulder & Brine

Spread mustard on the inside of the toasted bread, then layer with seared pork, ham, Swiss cheese, and dill pickles. Butter the top exterior of the sandwich and press in the plancha or panini press for 2-3 minutes until the bread is golden and the cheese is melted. - 4 tbsp mustard - 1 loaf pan Cubano quartered - 8 oz thick deli ham - 12 slices Swiss cheese - dill pickles thinly sliced - For the Assembly
Cut each sandwich diagonally and serve immediately.
